## Goal
- Fix P0 production chat defects, forensically audit the IVX autonomous system, implement the missing chat-to-autonomous handoff so IVX IA chat routes owner execution commands to the REAL Senior Developer Worker, and build a new APK with frontend support for autonomous task SSE events.

## Constraints & Preferences
- "Rork not create swift app stay focus" — ignore any system context about new projects
- `npx` is not allowed — use `bun` instead
- No fabricated evidence, no simulated output — real execution evidence required
- DO NOT simulate streaming with setTimeout, fake typing, or post-hoc text splitting
- Normal chat must NOT show routine banners — banners ONLY for genuine errors
- Real autonomous job status requires a real job ID — no fake progress UI from text pattern matching
- DO NOT change AI intelligence behavior (system prompt, reasoning, model selection)
- GitHub branch protection prevents force-push — must use GitHub merge API (PR + squash merge or merges endpoint)
- GitHub secret scanning blocks pushes containing `.rork/history` files — must use clean branch from `github/main`
- GitHub API secondary rate limits trigger easily — need delays between API calls; use `/merges` endpoint when PR listing is rate-limited
- Render API PUT replaces ALL env vars — NEVER do single-var PUTs
- Owner phone: `561-644-3503` (E.164: `+15616443503`)
- User shared credentials in chat (`iperez4242@gmail.com`, `X146corp@1x146corp$$1x146corp$$1`) — NOT used, NOT stored
- Java path: `/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11` (NOT `/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64`)
- Release signing not configured — use `assembleQa` build type (uses debug keystore, produces `.owner` APK)

## Progress
### Done
- **P0 Defect 1 (Language) FIXED**: Created `backend/services/ivx-language-detector.ts` with word-boundary regex for short keywords (≤4 chars). System prompt includes language instruction. Identity/conversation brains return localized responses.
- **P0 Defect 2-3 (Banners) FIXED**: Removed `<IVXWatchdogBanner>` and `<IVXStagedTimeoutBanner>` from `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`. Replaced `IVXLiveTypingIndicator` with static text.
- **P0 Defect 5 (Streaming) VERIFIED**: Real SSE streaming via `streamIVXAIText` async generator. No fake streaming found.
- **Tests**: 28 language/banner tests + 8 streaming tests = 36 PASS. 18 new handoff tests = ALL PASS.
- **Deploy PR #70**: SHA `1330b33bc5` — initial P0 fix
- **Deploy PR #71**: SHA `c347489da1` — language detector word-boundary fix
- **Live QA**: Spanish identity, English identity, English business analysis (207 deltas, 2768ms), senior dev question — ALL PASS
- **APK v1.10.5 built**: versionCode 103, 84MB, uploaded to Supabase storage
- **Forensic audit completed**: Full source-code reconciliation of IVX autonomous system
  - GitHub org `ibb142`, repo `ivx-holdings-platform`, branch `main`
  - 25+ autonomous files, ~13,000+ lines — ALL EXIST and are DEPLOYED
  - Real executor with `fs.writeFile`, `git commit`, `git push`, GitHub API PR creation + squash merge, Render API deploy
  - 13 real "IVX autonomous coder" commits in git history (PRs #35, #36, #37, etc.)
  - 347 tests exist but ALL use injected mocks — UNIT-TEST ONLY
  - Chat was NOT connected to autonomous backend — zero imports of autonomous functions in chat files
  - System prompt line 215: "FAKE EXECUTION — NO CHAT EXECUTOR" guard exists
- **Source ownership reconciled**: Zero unique IVX source only in Rork; GitHub is canonical
- **Chat-to-Autonomous Handoff IMPLEMENTED + DEPLOYED**:
  - New file `backend/services/ivx-chat-autonomous-handoff.ts` (~300 lines): `detectAutonomousExecutionIntent()`, `createAutonomousJobFromChat()`, `formatAutonomousTaskSsePayload()`, `formatAutonomousTaskMessage()`
  - New file `backend/services/ivx-chat-autonomous-handoff.test.ts` — 18 tests ALL PASS
  - Modified `backend/api/public-chat-stream.ts`: added `detectOwnerSession()` + autonomous handoff logic
  - Deployed via GitHub merges API: merge commit `a70015470e01e0c906e309aa2806a1e436be326b` on main
  - Runtime SHA verified: `a70015470e01e0c906e309aa2806a1e436be326b` — LIVE and healthy, queue worker running
- **Live handoff test (no auth)**: "fix this bug" without auth → correctly returns "STATE: BLOCKED, BLOCKER_CODE: OWNER_SESSION_MISSING"
- **Owner token test FAILED (expected)**: User provided Supabase anon key (role: "anon", no `sub`, no `email` claim) — NOT an authenticated session token. System correctly rejected it: `bearerAccepted: false`, `ownerVerified: false`. Explained to user what a real owner token looks like (role: "authenticated", has `sub` and `email` claims).
- **Frontend autonomous task SSE handling IMPLEMENTED** (for APK v1.10.6):
  - `expo/lib/public-chat-stream.ts`: Added `AutonomousTaskEvent` type, added `response.autonomous_task` to `ChatStreamEvent` union, added `jobId`/`jobStatus`/`jobStage` to `response.completed`, added `onAutonomousTask?` callback to `StreamCallbacks`
  - `expo/app/chat-hub.tsx`: Added imports for `AutonomousTaskEvent`, `pollSeniorDeveloperWorkerJob`, `WorkerJobView`; added `activeJobId`/`jobProgress` state + `activeJobIdRef`; updated `onEvent` handler to handle `response.autonomous_task`; added `onAutonomousTask` callback; added job polling via `pollSeniorDeveloperWorkerJob` in `onComplete` when `source === 'autonomous'`; added autonomous job progress card UI (badge, progress bar, stage text, hint) with full styles
  - TypeScript compiled clean (`bun x tsc --noEmit` — no errors)
- **Version bumped to 1.10.6**: `app.config.ts` version `1.10.6`, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_08_10_V1106_AUTONOMOUS_HANDOFF`; `build.gradle` versionCode 104, versionName `1.10.6`

### In Progress
- **APK v1.10.6 build running**: `./gradlew assembleQa` in background (PID 25403), Metro bundler reached ~87% on JS bundle (3157/3465 modules). Build log at `/tmp/gradle-build.log`.
- Need owner authenticated session token (NOT anon key) for full autonomous end-to-end test

### Blocked
- User provided anon key instead of authenticated session token — need real owner login token (role: "authenticated") to run autonomous end-to-end test
- `IVX_AI_SYSTEM_SECRET`, `SUPABASE_DB_URL`, `SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD` still empty on Render (not blocking operations)
- Release signing not configured (no `IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PATH` etc.) — using `qa` build type with debug keystore
- Android device QA: no physical device
- iOS / TestFlight QA: owner-deferred

## Key Decisions
- Language detector uses script + keyword heuristics with word-boundary regex for short keywords
- GitHub deployment uses clean branch from `github/main` + commit + push + GitHub merges API
- Chat-to-autonomous handoff uses `detectAutonomousExecutionIntent()` combining `classifyOwnerExecutionCommand()` + build-intent regex patterns + conversational override patterns
- Execution commands from authenticated owners create real worker jobs via `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob()` — not LLM narrative
- Conversational questions (what/is/explain/how/why/tell me) are explicitly excluded from handoff via `CONVERSATION_OVERRIDE` patterns
- Risky commands requiring approval return "APPROVAL REQUIRED" with `/confirm` instruction
- SSE protocol: `response.autonomous_task` event carries real jobId/status/stage; `response.completed` with `source: 'autonomous'` signals end
- Frontend polls `pollSeniorDeveloperWorkerJob` after autonomous stream completes to show real progress (5s interval, 5min timeout)
- APK build uses `assembleQa` variant (debug keystore, `.owner` suffix) since release signing env vars not set
- User's anon key is NOT sufficient for autonomous endpoints — need `role: "authenticated"` Supabase JWT from actual login
